headline: KN Agri Resources submits AGM scrutinizer report to the exchange
hook: Post-AGM compliance filing from KN Agri
summary: KN Agri Resources Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer's report from its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. This procedural filing completes the post-AGM compliance requirements for the company. Indian retail investors holding shares in KN Agri can verify the voting results through this exchange submission.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact
